development_device: Nothing Phone (3) / Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 / Nothing OS 4.1
notes: B51 is the current stable Beta 4. It adds independent CH1/CH2 master routing for KICK+TOM, HAT, BASS, SYNTH, CHORDS and BREAK, defaults all voices to normal stereo, keeps the corrected MIDI/OPTIONS layout, and routes the MINI909 hats, ride and crash through the BUS/global FX chain including DROP FX.
